deployment: refit on all admitted training animals; predictions take features only, never labels
future_rule: no new-animal parameter selection; any calibration from fit-side data only
inputs: log1p measured endogenous genes + measured position (declared axes); StandardScaler fitted on the training animals only
model: sklearn LogisticRegression L2 (default), lbfgs, max_iter 2000, tol 1e-6, random_state 20261112
not_transferable: A1 23-gene coefficients are not carried over; a new (e.g. hypothalamic) panel refits this recipe only on its own admitted training animals before any held-out test
reuse_scope: Probability recipe only. A1-specific weights require the exact 23-gene/depth assay and captured-target definitions. A new measured gene panel must be refit using only admitted training animals. Simulations remain synthetic evidence.
selection_basis: leave-one-animal-out OOF on the 2 exposed A1 animals; development-optimistic
shrinkage: p' = (1 - alpha) p + alpha q_fit, q_fit = group-balanced captured rate in the training animals only
